Commercial questions

Before moving a contract.

Can one customer have multiple sites?

Yes. Properties, jobs and service history can be associated with the relevant customer site.

Can PestFlow track bait stations?

Deployed assets can use QR or barcode identity with inspection and service history.

Can contracts generate recurring work?

Active service agreements can generate recurring service visits across the term.

Can customers retrieve reports?

The customer portal provides access to configured service and billing records, subject to plan and access settings.
